== Title ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍少佐</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">同じ位置の他の反乱軍（リーダーは除く）は全員、没収値＋1。同じ位置にボサンのスパイを配備する場合、フォースを消費しなくてよい。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ボブ・ハドソル少佐は典型的なタカ派のコレリア人士官だが、実戦では慎重な戦法を好む。ボサン宙域におけるレジスタンスの<u>リーダー</u>で、一帯のスパイ網をしっかりと掌握している。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rebel Commander]].

'''Lore''' — Major Bob Hudsol is a typical hawkish Corellian officer, but he prefers cautious tactics in actual combat. He is the leader of the resistance in Bothan space and firmly controls the region's spy network.

'''Game text''' — All other Rebels at the same location except leaders are forfeit +1. When deploying a Bothan spy at the same location, you need not spend Force.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
位置 vs site. Deploy without spending Force vs deploy free. Lore says he firmly controls the region's spy network, not that he developed strong ties to the Bothan spynet.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-rebelcommander.gif|Original English face]], [[Rebel Commander]].</ref>
